   **Presión publicitaria.**

      Ventana de reseñas: 10 sept 2026 - 29 sept 2026

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**

            2. _Jack Müller_, 10 sept 2026, 4/5: "I have ADHD so it's hard for me to stick to a routine or remember to dk stuff in general. This app really helps because it mixes my to does and routines with entertainment! The only downside is that there are a lot of ads if you don't buy premium"
